name: deco_stair_flight
description: Main staircase, strict top-down: 8 treads (30 px each) between 12-px stringers, value = height (south darkest, north lightest). Dresses the 3 x 3-unit stair trigger; one drawing for both floors.

treads.order: tread 1 = south (bottom, y 210..239) ... tread 8 = north (top, y 0..29)

rim: E and W outer edges only (x 0 and 239); N and S edges are walked across
